candidate.de: Koke je dugometražni prvijenac redatelja Igora Jelinovića, obiteljska drama o odnosima dviju sestara, obiteljskim vezama i nasljeđu koje otvara stare sukobe. Tonina vodi uspješnu računovodstvenu tvrtku i brine o cijeloj obitelji, dok njezina mlađa sestra, Luna, življe u svojoj vlastitoj svijesti.
candidate.en: Koke is the debut feature film of director Igor Jelinović, a family drama about the relationships between two sisters, family ties and the legacy that opens old conflicts. Tonina runs a successful accounting company and takes care of the whole family, while her younger sister, Luna, lives in her own world.

candidate.de: 17-godišnja Ainara nalazi se na raskrižju života kada treba odlučiti koju sveučilišnu karijeru odabrati. Iako je to ono što njezina majka želi, Ainara se osjeća vezana za svoju majku i bratove.
candidate.en: 17-year-old Ainara is at a crossroads in her life when she needs to decide which university career to choose. Although it's what her mother wants, Ainara feels tied to her mother and her brother.

candidate.de: Nakon rekordnog globalnog uspjeha filma Spider-Man: Put bez povratka, Spider-Man: Novo doba označava potpuno novo poglavlje za Petera Parkera i Spider-Mana.
candidate.en: After the record-breaking global success of the film Spider-Man: No Way Home, Spider-Man: New Era marks a completely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man.

candidate.de: John Miller bivši je rendžer koji je tijekom života prošao kroz mnoge bitke i neuspjehe. Sada se suočava s najtežim izazovom u svom životu - vraćanje svoje djece iz ruku kriminalnog podzemlja.
candidate.en: John Miller is a former ranger who has gone through many battles and failures throughout his life. Now he faces the toughest challenge of his life - getting his child back from the hands of the criminal underworld.

candidate.de: Earl Clancy, vlasnik kina u malom irskom gradu, jedan se petak navečer suočava s nizom problema koje pokušava riješiti paralelno s održavanjem filmske projekcije.
candidate.en: Earl Clancy, the owner of a small cinema in a small Irish town, faces a series of problems that he tries to solve parallel to the maintenance of the film projection.

candidate.de: Derya i Aziz, poznati umjetnički par iz Turske, žive naizgled skladnim obiteljskim životom sa svojom kćeri Ezgi. No nakon incidenta na premijeri njihove kazališne predstave, njihov život počinje propadati.
candidate.en: Derya and Aziz, a well-known artistic couple from Turkey, live a seemingly happy family life with their daughter Ezgi. But after an incident at the premiere of their theatrical performance, their life begins to fall apart.

candidate.de: Visokokonceptualni spektakl J. J. Abramsa i Davida Roberta Mitchella, s Anne Hathaway i Ewanom McGregorom u glavnim ulogama, donosi napetu priču koja će vas držati u neizvjesnosti do samoga kraja.
candidate.en: The high-concept spectacle of J.J. Abrams and David Robert Mitchell, starring Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor, brings a tense story that will keep you in suspense until the very end.

candidate.de: Mladići Chatila i Reda su izbjeglice iz Palestine koji trenutačno žive u Ateni na samom rubu društva, štedeći novac za lažne putovnice kako bi se vratili u svoju rodnu zemlju.
candidate.en: The young men Chatila and Reda are refugees from Palestine who are currently living in Athens on the fringes of society, saving money for fake passports to return to their homeland.

candidate.de: Ridley Scott donosi novu viziju postapokalipse, a Jacob Elordi vodi najopakiju borbu za preživljavanje nakon kraja svijeta.
